title: Employment Pension Plans Act
verified_how: fetched Alberta King's Printer Laws Online catalogue entry (ISBN 9780779861675): title 'Employment Pension Plans Act', Chapter/Regulation 'S.A. 2012, c. E-8.1', Status 'Office Consolidation', Current to 3/26/2026; the Laws Online index header states 'Acts current to 2026-08-31'
notes: Minimum standards for registered workplace pension plans, supervised by Alberta's Superintendent of Pensions. The contributory public pensions are federal - Canada Pension Plan, R.S.C. 1985, c. C-8, and Old Age Security, R.S.C. 1985, c. O-9 - while Alberta's own public-sector plans sit under the Public Sector Pension Plans Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. P-41.
